Available Services

Group Informational Call

  • FREE 30-minute group informational session with Denise to learn about our individual offerings and group classes at Advanced Ketogenic Therapies (AKT).
  • Bring your questions and learn how keto may be helpful for you.
  • No medical advice will be provided during these sessions.
Schedule

Jump-Start Assessment Call

20-minute interview to:

  • Assess your dietary/teaching needs
  • Recommend the best package for you/your loved one
  • Pair you with the best dietitian for your condition and circumstance
  • Investment: $50 USD
Schedule

One-Hour Ketogenic Diet Consultation

One-hour call, investment: $250 USD

Schedule

One-hour consultation with Denise

Schedule

Five-Call Keto Enhancement Package

A five-call package for adults already on keto who need professional support and accountability.

Learn more

Ten-Call Keto Starter/Rebuilder Package

A ten-call package recommended for those that are new to keto, those desiring precision keto (using KetoDietCalculator), pediatric patients, and those who need a keto diet overhaul.

Learn more

Twelve-Call Premium Concierge Package

Includes all benefits of the Keto Starter/Rebuilder package PLUS:

  • Concierge service
  • Night and weekend appointments
  • Direct texting to dietitian (with restrictions)
  • Premium meal planning
  • For hospitalized or group home patients
Learn more

Keto Maintenance and Monitoring

Monthly or quarterly maintenance and monitoring for graduates of Starter/Rebuilder, Enhancement, and Concierge packages.

Learn more

Professional Mentoring Services with Denise

Professional mentoring services for practitioners looking to enhance their expertise in ketogenic therapies.

Learn more

Services are available through remote, web-conference calls. ZOOM will be used unless otherwise arranged.
